claimBoundary.zh: 總體研究治理與可驗證狀態；不得以 umbrella 活動取代 child research evidence。
claimBoundary.en: Program governance and verified state only; umbrella activity cannot substitute for child-research evidence.

lineages.notes: GitHub main is the umbrella source of truth.

claimBoundary.zh: Candidate-v6 scientific evidence 可保留；formal Gate E 仍 fail-closed，現有 lineage 不得把 Gate F 視為合法進度。
claimBoundary.en: Candidate-v6 scientific evidence is retained; formal Gate E remains fail-closed and Gate F is not admissible progress in this lineage.

lineages.notes: Historical negative and integrity evidence remains immutable.

claimBoundary.zh: 目前只能確認 Candidate-v13 external-validity lineage 在 formal execution 前 infrastructure blocked；EV-B/EV-C 未執行。Integrity PASS 不等於 external-validity performance PASS。
claimBoundary.en: Candidate-v13 external validity is currently infrastructure-blocked before formal execution; EV-B/EV-C were not executed. Integrity PASS is not an external-validity performance PASS.

lineages.notes: WATCHED / PENDING admissibility. Must not auto-promote RT-01 maturity.

claimBoundary.zh: Gate B–E bounded evidence 可保留；Gate F 與後續失敗/失效 lineage 不得被改寫成 protected/OOD generalization PASS。
claimBoundary.en: Bounded Gate B–E evidence is retained; Gate F and later failed/invalid lineages cannot be rewritten as protected/OOD generalization PASS.

lineages.notes: Candidate-v9 is a terminal development FAIL; protected evaluation was not executed.

claimBoundary.zh: PARE v0.3 僅支持 benchmark-specific recovery/state-repair evidence；不等於 PAAV / RT-03 Action Verification 已建立。
claimBoundary.en: PARE v0.3 supports benchmark-specific recovery/state-repair evidence only; it does not establish PAAV / RT-03 Action Verification.

lineages.notes: Independent recovery research with bounded admitted evidence.
